design: Assistant-authored, inspected usability scenarios; not a held-out or owner-approved benchmark. Later turns use actual replies, not scripted tutor histories. Some control requests intentionally repeat prior tests.

turns.text: My name is Nisha and I enjoy pottery.
turns.expected: Ask a relevant question about pottery; do not invent details.

turns.text: What do you mean?
turns.expected: Explain the actual previous question in easier English.

turns.text: I enjoy pottery because I can make useful things.
turns.expected: Acknowledge the reason and develop the topic without asking that reason again.

turns.text: What is my name and what hobby did I mention? No follow-up.
turns.expected: Recall Nisha and pottery from learner evidence; honor no follow-up.

sessions.purpose: Food restriction, clarification, reason and revised preference

turns.text: I can't eat dairy and I would like lentil soup.
turns.expected: Keep the dairy restriction; ask a natural question about this meal without inferring ingredients.

turns.text: What do you mean?
turns.expected: Clarify the actual prior question without changing the subject.

turns.text: I would like lentil soup because it is warm.
turns.expected: Keep the restriction in context, do not ask why lentil soup was chosen again.

turns.text: Actually, I can eat dairy now, but I don't like dairy. I would like lentil soup.
turns.expected: Preserve permission versus dislike; do not claim inability or safe ingredients.

sessions.purpose: Commute, supplied duration, clarification and no-question control

turns.text: I take the bus to work because it costs less.
turns.expected: Develop the bus commute without asking the already-stated cost reason.

turns.text: The journey takes twenty minutes.
turns.expected: Use the duration as an answer about the bus journey; do not reask duration.

turns.text: What do you mean?
turns.expected: Explain the actual previous question simply.

turns.text: Please don't ask another question.
turns.expected: Acknowledge the request without a question or a command to elaborate.

sessions.purpose: Relative, upcoming interview, subject and cancellation

turns.text: My daughter has an interview at a college tomorrow.
turns.expected: Keep daughter and future timing; do not imply admission.

turns.text: My daughter is relieved because she caught her bus.
turns.expected: Keep the daughter/interview context without implying arrival or admission.

turns.text: She wants to study chemistry.
turns.expected: Connect her stated subject to the same daughter without reasking it.

turns.text: The interview was cancelled.
turns.expected: Acknowledge cancellation; do not imply she attended or remains scheduled.

sessions.purpose: Meal preparation, supplied reason, future event and stop

turns.text: I will cook noodles tomorrow.
turns.expected: Ask about a future meal, not its completed taste.

turns.text: I chose noodles because they are quick to make.
turns.expected: Develop preparation or preference without repeating the given reason.

turns.text: I have not cooked them yet.
turns.expected: Honor the uncompleted meal and resolve them from context.

turns.text: Thanks, that's enough practice for today.
turns.expected: End without another question.

sessions.purpose: Unknown fact, provided fact, recall and direct teaching

turns.text: Where does my cousin work?
turns.expected: Admit the workplace is unknown; mention cousin or work.

turns.text: My cousin works at a bakery.
turns.expected: Use the supplied workplace without inventing the cousin's role.

turns.text: Where does my cousin work? No follow-up.
turns.expected: Answer bakery from learner history without a follow-up.

turns.text: Could you compare learn and teach?
turns.expected: Explain both words correctly with an accessible example.
